message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run Test Suite

on:
  push:
    branches: [staging]
  pull_request:
    branches: [staging]

jobs:
  build:
    env:
      NODE_ENV: test

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v2.3.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-npm-

      - name: Install depdencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Test Suite
        run: npm run test",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs npm ci on every push/PR to staging with no dependency cache, so dependencies are re-fetched on each run. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) applies: package-lock.json is a stable lockfile input, repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and no equivalent cache already exists. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/.npm keyed on package-lock.json preserves npm ci and the test suite unchanged while reducing install time on warm runs, without weakening permissions or adding privileged actions, secrets, publishing, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
